items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Rather, Hal Willner, who was the musical director, he chose the material.

ctx.x: Did you like doing your t.v. programs? I know there was the evening with Annie Ross. Is working in t.v. much different than working for film?

It depends on who your director is. Doing a t.v. show is an art in itself. Movies, it really depends on your director, I think. That’s why Bob Altman is so prominent in my life. He would let you experiment. He said to me the first day, “I want everybody to come to the dailies.” I, like a lot of performers, hate to watch myself. I feel very self-conscious. I could have done that better or dah dah dah. I never listen to my recordings. I just don’t, because I feel oh, that could have been, or that could have been.…
The singles that are most associated with you are, of course, Twisted. Skylark is also one of the tunes, speaking of which.
